patterns.what_worked: Re-grepping every brief symbol before reading (all 2026-10-25 line numbers had moved) and counting the tick path call-by-call in the current tree; running the shipped simple_round under lua5.1 turned a suspicion into a proven user-visible defect (8 of 28 weapon speeds display 0.1s fast).
patterns.what_was_hard: No in-client profiler exists, so every per-tick/per-second figure is derived from source and has to be labelled as such; several Forever facts (issecretvalue/C_Secrets presence, C_Spell.IsSpellInRange addon-callability, which option setters re-run configure_bar_appearances) can only be closed in-client or by a later trace.
patterns.skill_gap: First session went inactive without a closing message/journal/report; had to be resumed by the Lead. Deliverables should be written as soon as the trace is complete rather than after further exploration.
